Icelandic original: „Sveitinn hjá fjölskyldu minni, fer þangað 2-3 á ári. Öll fjölskyldan mætir og er haldið stærsta sveitball á bóndabæ árlega. Ögurballið“
English gloss: “The team from my family's household goes there 2-3 times a year. The whole family meets and the largest team match [sveitball] is held annually at the farmers' association in the village. The team ball [öggurballi]”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
